Maria: Hey folks — scheduling a short retro for the storage incident (2026-03-10 degrad). Proposed: Tue 3/23 10:00am PT, 45m. Goal = agree on action owners + verify rollback playbook. Draft agenda: https://redwood/internals/pm-storage-retro (please add notes)
Jon: I'll be there. Can we add a small section on the rollback decision timeline? That was fuzzy during the incident.
Ash: I can attend. Suggest including infra on-call and the DB eng lead. @Elaine — can you join for the customer impact notes?
Elaine: OOO 3/22–3/24 but I can join remotely for the first 20m and will drop notes in the doc. Tagging @Sam for follow-up tracking.
Sam: I'll take follow-ups and own the action tracker. Will prepare a 1-slide summary of outstanding items.
calendar-bot: Event created "Storage incident retro" Tue 3/23 10:00am PT — invite sent to Maria, Jon, Ash, Sam, Elaine, infra-oncall
Maria: Thanks. Updated the agenda in the doc. Current agenda block:
```
1) Quick timeline recap (5m) — Jon
2) What went well / signals we missed (10m) — Ash
3) Root cause + technical detail (10m) — infra lead
4) Action items + owners (15m) — Maria/Sam
5) Follow-up cadence (5m)
```
Jon: Perfect. 45m works. Can we also call out a pre-read (logs + timeline) — link in doc.
Ash: I'll prepare the RCA slides and drop them in the doc by EOD Mon.
Sam: I'll make the action tracker and assign tentative owners during the retro; will follow up for any overdue items in 2 weeks.
Maria: One more ask — if you can't make it, add notes in the doc and mark 'rep' so we know someone covered it. Otherwise I'll run the meeting and post the postmortem summary after.
Jon: :thumbsup:
Elaine: noted. I'll add customer-impact bullets before I join.
Maria: Thanks everyone — I sent calendar invites. Last call for attendees/objections before I lock agenda (24h).
